caption: The drawing features two rectangular swatches set vertically on a light, cream-colored background. The upper swatch displays an intricate, swirling pattern featuring cream and beige scrolls outlined in red, set against a taupe-gray background with red decorative accents resembling stitched lines and feather-like shapes. The lower swatch shows a diamond lattice pattern in a pale cream color, overlaid sporadically with small decorative motifs composed of brown, feathery details encircling a central blue and red feature, set against the same light background. Both swatches are centered and separated by a gap, showing a contrast between the dense, complex design of the upper section and the more open, geometric layout of the lower section.
title: Vest Material
